text:
Aisha (recruiter): flagging offer for Soren (senior infra). Candidate requests 2026-07-12 start, relocating from EU. Manager asks $6k sign-on + provisional uplift +4% to base + benefits day 1. Can we route exception?
Priya (people-ops): one-line please with ETA for docs.
Aisha (recruiter): Ask: $6k one-time sign-on; +4% provisional uplift; benefits effective on start date. Reason: competitor counteroffer, high-impact role. Candidate can provide passport + address by 2026-06-28.
Diego (hiring manager): Confirming business impact: losing candidate delays a key migration by ~5 weeks. I approve sign-on from discretionary and back the uplift request.
Renee (comp): +4% needs comp review sign-off (policy: <=3% auto, 3-7% comp review). Upload manager memo and budget owner approval please.
Omar (finance): Finance needs GL code and headcount confirmation. One-time sign-on can be paid from hiring bucket. GL likely 5012, confirm.
Tess (onboarding): Enrollment note: benefits feed needs 72h lead time. For international relocation we need ID + address verification before feed; otherwise effective date may shift.
LegalBot: If approved, offer should include clause: "Benefits eligibility will commence on the employee's start date subject to carrier rules and timely verification of required documents."
Priya (people-ops): Routing plan: Manager -> Comp (Renee) -> Finance (Omar) -> People Ops final. Legal & Onboarding looped. Target decision by 2026-06-30 to hit 7/12 start.
Aisha (recruiter): uploaded manager memo and budget approval. Tagging @Renee @Omar.
Renee (comp): Reviewing memo now. If manager justification shows competitive offer and impact I'll sign after finance confirms run-rate. No committee needed under 7%.
Omar (finance): GL 5012 confirmed, headcount in tracker. Provisional finance ok pending final comp note.
Priya (people-ops): Next steps: Renee to post comp sign-off; Omar to confirm finance final; Legal to add clause; Tess to queue benefits feed once docs arrive. Target approvals by 2026-06-30.
Aisha (recruiter): thanks all, will push candidate for docs and update here. :thumbsup:
